steps.title: Verify the build deployed
steps.instruction: Open the Cloudflare dashboard -> Pages -> your project -> Deployments tab. Find the newest row.

success.label: OK -- deployment shows Success
success.assert: Newest deployment row status = 'Success' and its commit SHA matches the SHA you just pushed

failures.label: Build failed
failures.diagnosis_hint: Open the failed deployment -> View build log. Read the last ~20 lines and quote the first error line back verbatim -- most failures are a wrong build command or output directory in the project's Settings -> Builds & deployments.

failures.label: Can't find the Deployments tab
failures.diagnosis_hint: Confirm you're inside the Pages project (not the zone/DNS view) -- left nav should read Workers & Pages -> <project-name> -> Deployments.

failures.label: Newest isn't the SHA I expect
failures.diagnosis_hint: Check which branch triggers Pages builds (Settings -> Builds & deployments -> Production branch) and confirm the push actually landed on that branch, not a PR preview branch.

steps.title: Create the Access application BEFORE touching DNS
steps.instruction: Zero Trust dashboard -> Access -> Applications -> Add an application -> Self-hosted. Application domain = the exact hostname you are about to point DNS at (e.g. wiki.example.com). Add a policy requiring your own email.
steps.order_note: Must complete and save this step before Step 3 (DNS). If DNS is repointed first, the hostname is briefly served with no auth gate in front of it.

success.label: OK -- application saved with a policy
success.assert: Access -> Applications lists the new application, and its policy tab shows at least one allow rule (e.g. your email)

failures.label: Can't find Zero Trust / Access in the dashboard
failures.diagnosis_hint: Zero Trust is a separate top-level dashboard from the zone dashboard -- look for a shield icon or a separate URL under the account (not the DNS zone) view.

failures.label: Save button is disabled or errors
failures.diagnosis_hint: Application domain field usually requires the exact hostname with no scheme (no https://) and no trailing slash -- paste just the hostname.

steps.title: Generate the service-token secret locally
steps.instruction: In your terminal (not in this chat) run: openssl rand -hex 32   Copy the output and paste it into the Cloudflare Access service-token 'Client Secret' field yourself.

success.label: OK -- secret generated and pasted into the dashboard
success.assert: Cloudflare shows the service token saved (Client ID + Client Secret pair listed under Access -> Service Auth)

failures.label: openssl not found
failures.diagnosis_hint: Use `python3 -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_hex(32))"` as a fallback -- same effect, no extra install.

steps.title: Point DNS at the Pages project
steps.instruction: DNS tab for the zone -> Add record -> Type CNAME, Name = the same hostname from Step 2, Target = <project>.pages.dev, Proxy status = Proxied (orange cloud).
steps.order_note: Only do this after Step 2's Access application is live -- confirms the auth gate is already in front of the hostname before it resolves publicly.

success.label: OK -- record saved, shows Proxied
success.assert: DNS record list shows the CNAME with the orange-cloud (Proxied) icon, not grey (DNS only)

failures.label: Record already exists / conflicts
failures.diagnosis_hint: Look for a leftover A or CNAME record on the same name from a prior setup attempt -- delete it before adding the new CNAME, Cloudflare won't let two records share a name+type.

steps.title: Verify the whole path end to end
steps.instruction: In your terminal run: curl -I https://<your-hostname>

success.label: OK -- got a 302 redirect to cloudflareaccess.com
success.assert: Response headers show `HTTP/2 302` and a `location:` header pointing at a `cloudflareaccess.com` login URL

failures.label: Got a plain 200 with real content (no auth prompt)
failures.diagnosis_hint: The Access application's domain in Step 2 doesn't exactly match the hostname, or the DNS record isn't Proxied -- re-check both before retrying this step.

failures.label: Got a 522 or 526 (origin/SSL error)
failures.diagnosis_hint: DNS hasn't propagated yet or SSL/TLS mode (SSL/TLS -> Overview) isn't Full -- wait ~60s and retry once before escalating.
